The beat of the wings is only a memory trick.

items.hook: The great {0|wind} that hits {1|Taiwan, 台 tái} in summer: **typhoon**.

items.hook: A drawing of a {0|bird flying}: **to fly**.

items.hook: A {0|mouth facing down} over a {1|bowl of rice on its stand}: **food**.

items.hook: {0|Food} you {1|turn over, 反 fǎn} in the pot: **cooked rice**.
more: 反 fǎn, to turn over, gives the sound. Turning the rice is only a memory trick.
It also means a meal: 午飯 is lunch.

items.hook: With your {0|food}, a mouth open wide as a {1|yawn}: **to drink**.
more: 欠 draws an open mouth and gives the meaning. The food piece replaced an older sound piece.

items.hook: Enough {0|food} to fill you like a stuffed {1|bun, 包 bāo}: **full**.
more: 包 bāo, bun, gives the sound. The stuffed bun is only a memory trick.

items.hook: {0|Food} with the edges {1|crossed, 交 jiāo} and pinched shut: a **dumpling**.
more: 交 jiāo, to cross, gives the sound. The crossed edges are only a memory trick.

items.hook: Flat {0|food} baked from dough: a **cake**.
{0|Food} for the {1|sheep, 羊 yáng} every day: **to care for**.
more: 羊 yáng, sheep, gives the sound. Feeding the sheep is only a memory trick.

items.hook: {0|Food} set out for everyone at the table: a **meal**.
No {0|food} for {1|me, 我}: **hungry**.
more: 我 wǒ, I, was the sound long ago. "No food for me" is only a memory trick.

items.hook: {0|Food} still on the table when everyone is full: **left over**.
The {0|food} hidden inside the dumpling: the **filling**.
Where an {1|official, 官 guān} on the road gets {0|food} and a bed: a **hall**.
more: 官 guān, official, gives the sound. The travelling official is only a memory trick.

items.hook: Putting {0|food} into a waiting mouth: **to feed**.
Soft white {0|food}, steamed until it swells: a **steamed bun**.
{0|Hair} above an {1|eye}: the head, and the **counting word for songs**.
The {1|sweet} smell of fresh {0|grain}: **fragrant**.
more: Scholars do not all agree on how to read this old drawing.

items.hook: A drawing of a {0|horse}: a **horse**.
more: The four dots look like 灬 fire today, but they are part of the horse.

items.hook: {1|Adding, 加 jiā} a {0|horse} to the cart and taking the reins: **to drive**.
more: 加 jiā, to add, gives the sound. Adding a horse is only a memory trick.

items.hook: A {0|horse} racing so fast it makes {1|history, 史 shǐ}: **to speed along**.
more: 史 shǐ, history, gives the sound. Making history is only a memory trick.
駕駛 as a whole means to drive.

items.hook: On a {0|horse}, a {1|strange, 奇 qí} new way to travel: **to ride**.
more: 奇 qí, strange, gives the sound. The strange new way is only a memory trick.

items.hook: Selling a lame {0|horse} as a sound one: **to cheat**.
more: Selling a lame horse is only a memory trick.

items.hook: A {0|horse} with its head held high: **proud**.
Trying out a {0|horse} before you buy it: **to test**.
more: In 經驗 it is what you have been through: experience.

items.hook: A {0|horse} rearing up, and you keep a {1|respectful, 敬 jìng} distance: **startled**.
more: 敬 jìng, to respect, gives the sound. The respectful distance is only a memory trick.

items.hook: Old {0|bones} left lying in the mud: **dirty**.
more: The bones in the mud is only a memory trick.

items.hook: Old {0|bones} dug out of the ground: **dirty**.
{0|Bone} and everything built on it: the **body**.
A drawing of a {0|tall building}: **tall**.
{0|Long hair} growing from the head: **hair**.
{0|Long hair} let down, soft as {1|pine, 松 sōng} needles: **loose**.

items.hook: {0|Long hair} growing on the chin: a **beard**.
A {0|fight} breaking out in the {1|market}: **noisy**.
A {0|ghost} that draws you in: **charm**.
A drawing of a {0|fish}: a **fish**.
more: It looks like 田 field over 灬 fire today, but it is one drawing.

more: Its first meaning was tasty. The name Lu only borrowed its sound.

items.hook: A {0|fish} just caught and a {1|sheep, 羊} just killed: **fresh**.
more: 羊 yáng, sheep, was the sound long ago. The fresh meat is only a memory trick.
References do not all agree on the job of each piece here.

items.hook: A drawing of a {0|bird}: a **bird**.
A {0|bird} waddles to the pond and paddles away, quacking: a **duck**.
more: Waddling and paddling away is only a memory trick.

items.hook: A big white {0|bird} that honks at you in the park: a **goose**.

items.hook: {1|Hemp stalks} hung up to dry under a {0|shelter}: **hemp**.

items.hook: {0|Millet} cooked so soft it glues to your fingers: **sticky**.

items.hook: A small {0|black} mark on the dial: **o'clock**.

items.hook: A {1|hand with a beater} striking a {0|drum}: a **drum**.
more: 鼓勵 as a whole means to encourage.

items.hook: A drawing of a {0|rat}: a **rat**.
The old drawing of a {0|nose}, with a sound piece added below: the **nose**.
